_comment: Which Z-Anatomy objects become which Osteology Lab model. Names are Z-Anatomy object names without the .r/.l side suffix; the exporter tries <name>.r, then <name>. Right-sided structures are exported; the viewer mirrors on X for a left bone (Z-Anatomy's .l meshes are mirror copies of .r — equal vertex counts, mirrored x). Read by scripts/osteology/export-zanatomy.py.
